case_families.name: authentication
case_families.proof_required: central verified account; unknown/disabled accounts cannot link to other Person; authenticated positive followed by revoked/expired negative

case_families.name: scope_IDOR
case_families.proof_required: A/B positive within own scope; read/mutate/export/file/approval deny other scope and expired assignment before count/snippet

case_families.name: CSRF
case_families.proof_required: actual authenticated mutating action rejects missing/wrong CSRF or foreign Origin according to verified design; legitimate same-origin action succeeds

case_families.name: XSS
case_families.proof_required: stored/reflected rich-text payload inert in browser/preview/export; safe supported content remains usable

case_families.name: SSRF
case_families.proof_required: future server URL adapter rejects metadata/private ranges, DNS rebinding and redirects; approved origin still works without external-link fetch from XLSX

case_families.name: upload_isolation
case_families.proof_required: magic/MIME/quarantine/scan/version ACL; malicious ZIP/formula/external link fails within tested memory/time without source commit

case_families.name: secret_scans
case_families.proof_required: supported current/history/binary/archive artifact coverage and known TEST canary detection; no real matched values printed

case_families.name: dependencies
case_families.proof_required: advisory scan complete for lockfile/version; triage severity/reachability and remediation evidence; timeout is unknown

case_families.name: log_masking
case_families.proof_required: TEST canaries do not appear unmasked in app/driver/worker/CI/APM collectors; required security event remains; collector outage does not leak

case_families.name: session_revocation
case_families.proof_required: existing token/session denied after logout/account disable/assignment change according to current policy; no client role cache bypass

case_families.name: job_privileges
case_families.proof_required: worker current scope/delegation/ACL before effects; duplicate/out-of-order/crash-before-ACK does not duplicate source or receipts

case_families.name: approval_transactions
case_families.proof_required: maker/checker/approver independent; current verified authority limits/time/evidence; concurrent seat/budget/stock cannot violate database invariants

case_families.name: public_results_minor_cache
case_families.proof_required: approved fields only across API/HTML/search/export/cache; withdrawn/draft and minor fields suppressed; historical snapshot retained

case_families.name: rights_retention_hold
case_families.proof_required: actual appointed authority decides purpose/basis/rights; legal hold prevents destruction; approved destruction retains audit and correction creates version

case_families.name: native_RLS_privileges
case_families.proof_required: real PostgreSQL limited role/current context cannot read other scope or forge provenance for authorization; roles no superuser/BYPASSRLS; connection context reset
